server.description: Hostname or IP address of GlobalProtect server (portal or gateway); required

gateway.description: If true, authenticate to gateway instead of portal

no_cookies.description: If true, disable cookie usage/storage entirely

cookies_file.description: Path to cookie storage file; implies cookie usage unless no_cookies is set

cert_file.description: Path to PEM file containing client certificate (optionally with private key)

key_file.description: Path to PEM file containing client private key, if separate from cert_file

clientos.description: Override for clientos parameter; must be one of: Windows, Linux, Mac

extra_fields.description: List of extra form fields to inject into login form (e.g. 'magic-cookie-value=deadbeef01234567') — each item should be a key=value string

pkexec_openconnect.description: If true, use pkexec to run openconnect

sudo_openconnect.description: If true, use sudo to run openconnect

no_verify.description: If true, skip TLS certificate verification

external_browser.description: If true, launch external browser (for debugging)

uri_mode.description: If true, treat server as complete SAML entry URI (not GlobalProtect server)

openconnect_extra.description: List of extra command-line arguments to append to openconnect invocation (must be preceded by -- if needed)
